description: Source code for Android XML reference provider in IntelliJ IDEA plugin, handling reference resolution and code completion for Android XML tags and classes.

classes.name: AndroidXmlReferenceProvider
classes.description: Provides references and code completion for Android XML tags and class names within IntelliJ IDEA.

classes.name: MyClassOrPackageReference
classes.description: Represents a reference to a class or package in Android XML, with resolve and code completion logic.

methods.name: getReferencesByElement
methods.description: Returns references for a given XML tag element, including class and package references.

methods.name: addReferences
methods.description: Adds class or package references based on the XML tag and element text.

methods.name: areReferencesProvidedByReferenceProvider
methods.description: Checks if references should be provided for a given AST node based on its context.

methods.name: computeBaseClass
methods.description: Computes the base class name for a given XML tag context.
